The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: “Later” author Stephen King stops by to chat. “Tell Me Your Secrets” star Amy Brenneman joins Drew. “Flora & Ulysses” star Ben Schwartz joins Drew and Ross in Drew’s News. Plus, Drew tries the latest food trends on TikTok with chef Michelle Park.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: ”America’s Got Talent's” Terry Crews and his wife Rebecca chat. Drew is joined by students who launched a zine which celebrates chefs of color. Kwame Onwuachi makes Jollof Rice with Jerk Rack of Lamb. Young Emperors give a married couple a fashion update.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Comedian Nikki Glaser and her mom Julie Glaser stop by to chat. Then, in Retro Cooking, Drew brings the 1950s tuna noodle casserole back to life. Seven-year-old Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, stops by to whip up some Shirley Temples with Drew.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Neil Patrick Harris on the inspiration behind Box One, an ever-evolving game that he co-created. Pastry chef Duff Goldman whips up chocolate peppermint cupcakes. "The Unicorn" star Michaela Watkins chats. Plus, celebrity astrologer Aliza Kelly.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew is joined by Kendra Scott for her first Small Business Challenge. Edgar Ramirez chats. Drew spotlights Chopped Champion Chef Roshara Sanders who teaches Drew how to make a jerk crab cake sandwich. Cleo Wade chats about her first children’s book.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew sits down for an exclusive conversation with Dylan Farrow on her HBO Max docuseries “Allen vs. Farrow.” Katherine Schwarzenegger Pratt chats. Chef Pilar Valdes and founder of Nguyen Coffee Supply Sahra Nguyen share ways to use coffee in the kitchen.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Kevin Bacon joins Drew. Rapper and chef Action Bronson discusses his weight loss and whips up Backyard Markham Street Style Lamb Burgers. Meet the founders of My Fairy Godfathers, a non-profit dedicated to helping women in need by providing makeovers.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew kicks-off Beauty Week: Part Deux. Lena Dunham joins Drew. Michele Obama’s stylist Meredith Koop gives a makeover for a mom in need of a date night refresh. Makeup artist and founder of Uoma Beauty Sharon Chuter co-pilots a beauty-themed Drew’s News.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: “To Tell The Truth” hosts Anthony Anderson and his mom Doris Bowman chat. Soleil Moon Frye discuss her new doc “Kid 90,” an intimate look at young Hollywood starlets in the '90s. Drew and Ross Mathews serve the news sunny-side up in Drew's News.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew’s Halloween show! "Emily in Paris's" Ashley Park stops by. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares tips to repurpose leftover Halloween candy. Drew's "Stans for Stains: Halloween Edition." A curated list of Drew's favorites in "The Weekender."

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: “A Little Late with Lilly Singh” host Lilly Singh stops by to chat. “Hot Ones” host Sean Evans joins Drew and Ross in Drew’s News. Butcher and author of “The Butcher Babe Cookbook” Loreal Gavin shares her special marinade revealing her secret ingredient.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Grammy-nominated musician Josh Groban chats. Drew is joined on Zoom by kids of her show staff and The Craft Studio founder to create a fun flower craft. Executive Culinary Director at VICE Media Farideh Sadeghin teaches Drew how to make a Frito Pie.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew kicks-off her week-long Halloween celebration with Netflix’s “Hubie Halloween” star Adam Sandler. Then, actress Jill Kargman and Drew visit Pumpkin Blaze Long Island! Plus, Drew tackles dating at any age in her signature “Love Bug” segment.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: “Barb + Star Go To Vista Del Mar” stars Kristen Wiig, Jamie Dornan and Annie Mumolo chat. Design week starts with interior designing duo Nate Berkus and Jeremiah Brent. Interior designer Mikel Welch helps transform a bedroom being shared by two sisters.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Actress Julianna Margulies stops by to discuss her new memoir “Sunshine Girl: An Unexpected Life.” Then, “Outer Banks” star Chase Stokes joins Drew. Culinary contributor Eitan Bernath whips up his favorite summer dish a watermelon feta arugula salad.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Game Show week concludes with “People Puzzler” host Leah Remini. Then, Drew is talking all things beauty with beauty influencer Patrick Starrr. Plus, Drew and Ross Matthews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all-new “Drew’s News.”

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Drew spotlights women in signature "Wildflower." Laura Sobiech and Director Justin Baldoni discuss her son Zach’s battle with cancer inspiring a number one song. In "Mom’s Time Out," Drew surprises one deserving mom with an all-expenses paid vacation!

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Host of Nickelodeon’s new animal talent show "Unleashed" comedian Gabriel Iglesias shares with Drew one of his favorite acts. Cast of the new film "Friendsgiving" including Malin Akerman, Kat Dennings, Aisha Tyler and Chelsea Peretti stop by to chat.

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Week-long Halloween celebration w/ "The Witches" star Anne Hathaway. "The Daily Show's" Dulce Sloan introduces some single men & their furry sidekicks! Drew goes down to the basement of the CBS Studios with ghosthunter Steve Gonsalves to hunt for ghosts!

videos.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
videos.overview: Jessica Simpson chats. Drew tries something new based on viewer requests in new segment “Drew Does…,” first up line dancing. Co-author of “Chef Lenny Cooking for Humans” bearded dragon Chef Lenny & his owner Valerie Musser whip up Ma’s Famous Carrot Cake.
